chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Abdullah ibn Musa, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, who said:

I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: “Indeed, for the boy there will be a ghaybah (occultation) before he rises.” He said: I said, “And why?” He said: “He fears,” and he gestured with his hand toward his stomach.

Then he said: “O Zurarah, and he is al-Muntazar, and he is the one regarding whose birth doubt will arise. Among them is one who says: ‘His father died without a successor’; and among them is one who says: ‘A pregnancy’; and among them is one who says: ‘Indeed, he was born two years before the death of his father.’ And he is al-Muntazar, except that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, loves to test the Shi'ah. So at that time, the falsifiers will fall into doubt, O Zurarah.”

He said: I said, “May I be made your ransom, if I reach that time, what should I do?” He said: “O Zurarah, if you reach this time, then supplicate with this du'a: ‘O Allah, make me know Yourself, for if You do not make me know Yourself, I will not know Your Prophet. O Allah, make me know Your Messenger, for if You do not make me know Your Messenger, I will not know Your Hujjah. O Allah, make me know Your Hujjah, for if You do not make me know Your Hujjah, I will go astray from my religion.’”

Then he said: “O Zurarah, there must inevitably be the killing of a boy in al-Madinah.” I said, “May I be made your ransom, is it not the army of al-Sufyani that will kill him?” He said: “No, rather the army of the family of so-and-so will kill him. It will come until it enters al-Madinah, then seize the boy and kill him. So when they kill him in rebellion, hostility, and ظلم, they will not be granted respite. Then at that moment, await the faraj, if Allah wills.”

key_terms.الدُّعَاءِ: the supplication taught for that time
key_terms.الْغُلَامِ: the boy, referring here to the awaited Imam
key_terms.الْفَرَجِ: relief; the divinely granted deliverance associated with the Imam's rise
key_terms.حُجَّتَكَ: Your Hujjah; the divine proof of Allah upon creation
key_terms.غَيْبَةً: occultation; a period of concealment before the Imam's rise
key_terms.وِلَادَتِهِ: his birth, concerning which people will dispute
key_terms.يَمْتَحِنَ: to test; Allah testing the Shi'ah through the circumstances

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach for the time of the ghaybah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the ghaybah (occultation) of the awaited Imam and the confusion that will surround his birth and identity as a trial for the Shi'ah. It teaches a foundational du'a for steadfast recognition of Allah, His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and His Hujjah, and it also mentions a sign preceding the faraj.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Al Hassan Bin Musa Al Khashab, from Abdullah Bin Musa, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘For the boy there would be an Occultation before he<sup>asws</sup> arises’. I said, ‘And why (would that be so)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> would fear’, and he<sup>asws</sup> gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> to his<sup>asws</sup> belly.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Zurara, and he<sup>asws</sup> is awaiting, and he<sup>asws</sup> is the one<sup>asws</sup> for whom they will doubt regarding his<sup>asws</sup> birth. From them would be one who would be saying, ‘His<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> died without a replacement (Imam<sup>asws</sup>)’, and from them would be one who would be saying, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was borne (i.e. his<sup>asws</sup> mother<sup>as</sup> was expecting when his<sup>as</sup> father<sup>as</sup> passed away)’; and from them would be one who would be saying, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was born before the death of his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> by two years, and he<sup>asws</sup> is awaited, apart from that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majetic Loved to Test the Shias’. Thus, during that, the false ones would be raising doubts, O Zurara!’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! If I were to come across that time period, which thing should I do?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Zurara! If you come across this time period, so supplicate with this supplication, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Acquaint Yourself<sup>azwj</sup> to me, for if You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Acquaint Yourself<sup>saww</sup> to me, I will not (be able to) recognise Your<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, for if You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, I would not recognise Your<sup>azwj</sup> Divine Authority. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Divine Authority, for it You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Acquaint me with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Divine Authority, I would stray from my Religion’’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Zurara! It is inevitable that a boy be murdered in Al-Medina’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Wouldn’t he be killed by the army of Al-Sufyani?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but it would be the army of the Clan of so and so which would kill him. It would come until it enters Al-Medina, so they would seize the boy. So when they kill him by transgression, and animosity, and injustice, they would not be given a respite. So, during that, anticipate the relief (Rising of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>), if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from ‘Abdallah ibn Musa from ‘Abdallah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who has said the following.

“The young boy will disappear from the public sight before his rise (with divine power)” The narrator has said, “I then asked, “Why (would that has to take place)?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “He will be afraid.” He pointed out with his hand to his midsection.

Then he said, “O zurara, “He is the one whose reappearance is expected. He is the one whose coming to this world through birth will be doubted. Certain people will say, “his father died without leaving any son behind.” Certain others will say, “Just before the dead of his father his mother conceived him.” Still others will say, “He was born two years before the death of his father.” He is the one whose reappearance is expected. The fact is that Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, loves to try and test the Shi‘a (his followers). It in such a condition that people of falsehood will raise doubts, O Zurara).”

The narrator has said, “I then said, May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, if will be alive at the time of his rise with divine power what should I do?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “O Zurara, if you will live up to such time then say the following prayer. “O Lord make me know You for if you would not make me know You I will not know Your prophet. O Lord, make me know Your Messenger, for if You would not make me know your Messenger I will not know the one who possesses Your authority over the creatures. O Lord make me know the one who possesses Your authority over the creatures for if You will not make me know him I will stray away from my religion.”

Then he said, “O Zurara, it is necessary that a young boy must be murdered in the city of Madina.” I then said, “May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, would he not be killed in the hands of the army of al-Sufyani?” He said, “No, but the army of the tribe of so and so will kill him. They will come to inter Madina, thus, they take hold of the young boy and kill him. When they will murder him in transgression, animosity and injustice they will not then be given respite. At such time good news will be expected, if Allah would so will.”
